description: This source file implements utility functions for handling 'automation' entities, including parsing, serialization, disassembly, assembly, and file I/O operations related to automation configurations, metadata, and specifications. It supports JSON and XML formats, with specialized handling for different specification types like Sheens and Legacy. The code includes functions for creating, destroying, encoding, decoding, disassembling, and assembling automation data, facilitating a structured approach to automation management within the project.
